verification_report.summary: Correct under the stated accepted prerequisites. All 19 proof items, comprising 104 deductions, were checked in textual order. Weighted ideal membership is equivalent to finite norm; finite dimensionality, basis independence, the extremal formula and integral B=N are valid. The local formula Phi=(1/m)log(sum |f_j|^2)-chi gives genuine analytic singularities and closed positive Bergman curvature exactly when N>0; the zero-space case is explicitly excluded from genuine potentials. Bounded-weight comparison and exact metric/weight gauge covariance have the correct constants and signs. Poincare-Lelong and Gauduchon Stokes prove both degree obstructions, including triviality at degree zero and vanishing of a positive current with zero degree. The P1 example correctly disproves multiplication closure for H_m, while W_m forms a graded algebra without any coherence claim. On the curve, exp(-mu) gives precisely the floor and ceiling thresholds, including integer coefficients. Removing each logarithm leaves a bounded subharmonic local potential, so the residual curvature measure is nonpolar and equals the extended measure of mass ell-d. Riemann-Roch and Serre duality apply once the bundle degrees exceed 2g-2; the separate evaluation argument proves bounded dimensions at ell=d, including r=0. The accepted infinite-mass witness gives H_m=C and constant Bergman potentials, hence zero Bergman currents and m^(-n)dim H_m tending to zero despite infinite Hermitian mass. External theorem searches and source checks were completed; the supplied SGPT manuscript confirms the distinct positivity and kernel-weight hypotheses of its asymptotic results ([SGPT](https://mingchenxia.github.io/Lectures/SGPT_final.pdf), Sections 7.4, 10 and 14.3). No such result is transferred to an arbitrary Hermitian background. No critical errors or gaps were found.
